events.name: Street braai at the park
events.start_text: Someone's lit a braai at the park. The smell drifts down the street.
events.end_text: The braai at the park is winding down.

events.name: Load-shedding (stage 2)
events.start_text: Load-shedding! Stage 2 until 21:00. The lights go out across Vleirand.
events.end_text: The power is back. Somebody cheers down the street.
